children: Morocco will offer a soft wheat import subsidy of 20.80 dirhams per quintal ($22.2 per metric ton) for the September 16 to September 30 period as the country resumes imports of the staple cereal, a notice from grain office ONICL showed.

ONICL announced last month that it would propose rolling subsidies from September 16 until December 31, effectively relaunching wheat imports after they were halted in June to prioritise an improved local harvest this year.
Traders are watching to see how importers like Morocco cover their requirements amid war disruption to massive Russian and Ukrainian exports through the Black Sea.
